name: Gitea
description: Forge Git légère : dépôts, issues, pull requests.
compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    container_name: gitea
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - USER_UID={{PUID}}
      - USER_GID={{PGID}}
    ports:
      - "3002:3000"
      - "2222:22"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/data
